verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's core architecture is built for high-cardinality querying: the Query Builder supports GROUP BY/WHERE clauses on any field including relational span fields like user id or request id without predefined indexes or pre-aggregation, and BubbleUp is designed specifically to surface outliers across high-cardinality dimensions. This is Honeycomb's flagship differentiator, well documented and corroborated by community usage describing it as accelerating investigations across raw event data. missing for 10: no explicit hands-on benchmark showing cardinality limits or index-free performance at scale, and no independent quality audit beyond community anecdote.
